alt: A photo of the head, neck, and shoulders of a great blue heron (Ardea herodias) with its beak slightly open, facing to the right. It has a long pale neck, a long sharp gray and yellow-orange beak, white head with dark blue-gray stripes above its eyes, long thin dark blue-gray crest feathers on the back of its head, and bright yellow irises. The background is out of focus gray-blue water.
